name: lightpanda-mcp-server
description: Lightpanda headless browser - 11x faster, 9x less memory than Chrome. Web automation for AI agents: fetch pages, extract data, fill forms, click elements, search the web.
title: Lightpanda Browser

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.title: Fetch Webpage
tools.description: Fetch a webpage with full JavaScript execution. Returns the page title and text content. Use this to read articles, documentation, or any web content that requires JS rendering.

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before extracting content

waitTime.description: Optional additional wait time in ms (max 10000)

tools.name: web_extract_links
tools.title: Extract Links
tools.description: Extract all links from a webpage. Returns list of URLs with their link text. Useful for crawling, finding resources, or navigation.

url.description: The URL to extract links from

tools.name: web_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot Page
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a webpage. Returns base64-encoded PNG image. Useful for visual verification or when page layout matters.

tools.name: web_evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate JavaScript
tools.description: Execute custom JavaScript on a webpage and return the result. The script runs in the page context with full DOM access.

script.description: JavaScript code to execute (must return a value)

tools.name: web_click
tools.title: Click Element
tools.description: Click an element on a webpage and return the resulting page state. Useful for navigation, button clicks, or triggering actions.

selector.description: CSS selector of element to click

tools.name: web_fill
tools.title: Fill Form
tools.description: Fill form fields on a webpage. Provide an array of selector/value pairs to populate inputs, textareas, etc.

value.description: Value to type into the input

tools.name: web_search
tools.title: Web Search
tools.description: Search the web using a search engine. Returns top results with titles, links, and snippets.
